authored_scenes.display_name: 初始岛屿 / Hub 外部码头
航行大场景 / 雾海航道

scene_unit_prototypes.scale_rule: 1.0x player_unit
island landmark >= 2.0x player height; provides readable safe ground mass
dock path clear width >= 1.1x player and visually connects island to ship
docked ship hull >= 2.0x player height and readable as the boarding target
boarding passage clear width >= 1.1x player and directly connects dock to ship door
large envelope silhouette reads above docked hull for player readability and never implies passability

scene_unit_prototypes.display_name: 初始岛屿水线 / 云海边界
scene_unit_prototypes.scale_rule: wide boundary larger than player and readable as non-walkable edge
0.8-1.3x player-readable interactable; smaller than cockpit bay and larger than small cargo props

scene_unit_prototypes.display_name: 航行船首 / 舱窗前景
scene_unit_prototypes.scale_rule: ship bow foreground spans cockpit scale and remains readable against player_unit size
air lane clear width >= 3.0x player and readable as active driving space
beacon spacing remains readable from cockpit view and references player_unit scale
fog bank larger than player and ship proxy; must leave beacon direction readable
wreckage gaps remain wider than 1.1x player and readable as steering choices
bird silhouette reads larger than player and ship foreground but remains visual-only
destination silhouette grows in cockpit view and references player_unit travel scale
retreat beacon clear interaction width >= 1.1x player and visible from cockpit view
mist island mass >= 2.0x player height and readable as quiet destination ground
path clear width >= 1.1x player and connects return ship to search wreck
wreck body about 6 player-widths and readable as the search target

scene_unit_prototypes.display_name: 雾灯残骸搜索扫描锚点
scene_unit_prototypes.scale_rule: scan anchor overlaps wreck body and remains readable against player_unit scale

scene_unit_prototypes.display_name: 雾灯残骸返航飞艇船体
scene_unit_prototypes.scale_rule: return ship hull about 5 player-widths and readable as the departure target
return helm clear interaction width >= 1.1x player

scene_unit_prototypes.display_name: 雾灯残骸返航起飞尾迹
scene_unit_prototypes.scale_rule: takeoff trail reads against player_unit scale as return direction and never implies walkable ground
water boundary spans the viewport and is larger than player_unit
landmark >= 2.0x player height
path clear width >= 1.1x player
resource node 1.5-2.5x player width; readable as ore, not floor texture
passage clear width >= 1.1x player
blocked boundary larger than player

routes.description: 低威胁雾带训练航线，适合验证首轮搜索、压力反馈和撤离闭环。
通往废旧集市边缘的中程航线，保留给后续集市与修复材料内容扩展。
通往赭色资源浮岛的正式中程航线，用于验证条带状铁矿采集、资源写入和返航结算。

search_points.description: 半沉的导航灯架，能稳定产出一箱信标水晶并建立第一段载货压力。
云层剪切带中的高价值残片，搜索时触发环境威胁并压低船体完整度。
靠近返航信标的补给箱，用于完成收益锁定和撤离语义验证。
